summary: Enbridge Inc. filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten offering of common shares in Canadian dollars, with amounts and pricing left blank. The filing cites use of net proceeds to partially fund announced acquisitions and for general financial flexibility. RBC, CIBC, Scotiabank, BMO, TD and National Bank are listed as underwriters. A concurrent Canadian offering is referenced. Directors and officers indicated interest in roughly $1.82 million of shares. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not itself a special situation; the underlying acquisitions are not detailed here.
